country: Al Mamlakah al Arabiyah as Suudiyah
places: Saudi National Day (Unification of the Kingdom)

fields.climate: harsh, dry desert with great temperature extremes
fields.hazards: frequent sand and dust storms; volcanism: little activity in the past few centuries, despite many volcanic formations; volcanoes include Harrat Rahat, Harrat Khaybar, Harrat Lunayyir, and Jabal Yar
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, iron ore, gold, copper
fields.farm: milk, dates, chicken, wheat, tomatoes, watermelons, potatoes, olives, eggs, onions
fields.exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, plastics, alcohols, ships
fields.industries: crude oil production, petroleum refining, basic petrochemicals, ammonia, industrial gases, sodium hydroxide (caustic soda), cement, fertilizer, plastics, metals, commercial ship repair, commercial…
fields.religions: Muslim (official; citizens are 85-90% Sunni and 10-12% Shia), other (includes Eastern Orthodox, Protestant, Roman Catholic, Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, and Sikh)
fields.legal: Islamic (sharia) system with some elements of Egyptian, French, and customary law; commercial disputes handled by special committees
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal for municipal elections

holiday.name: Saudi National Day (Unification of the Kingdom)

fields.military: voluntary military service for men (17-40) and women (typically 21-40, although maximum age may vary by role); no conscription
